description: Sample warming centers for testing the map with many centers: the 28 in sample-centers.geojson, then 1,472 invented ones. The invented centers' names, addresses, coordinates, hours and details are all made up, and an address need not match its borough or its place on the map. Every phone number is (000) 000-0000. Every website is NYC Emergency Management's, as a placeholder.
